scope: Exported Windows SMTC evidence, final commit records and linked report; private handoff excluded
method: Personal username/profile path, QQ email and credential-header pattern scan
Exact substring scan against current private queue metadata/URLs of length at least eight characters
short_metadata_protection: Outputs reviewed as booleans, aliases, protocol states, generic counters, test names and source/build hashes; private fixtures removed
intentional_public_account_information: GitHub fork/account links and noreply identity required for publication; no private author email
limitations: Pattern scan supplements schema review; not a systemwide write trace
git_export_byte_preservation: Nested .gitattributes disables text normalization; every published blob is compared byte-for-byte before push.
